description: Create a new Security Case Evidence in OneUptime. Returns the created Security Case Evidence object with its ID. Use this to add new Security Case Evidence to your project. Note: projectId is inferred from your API key — you do not need to provide it.

description.description: What the evidence shows, and where and how it was collected.
description.example: This is an example of very long text content that might be stored in this field. It can contain a lot of information, such as detailed descriptions, comments, or any other lengthy text data that needs to be stored in the database.

fileId.description: ID of the uploaded file, for File evidence: upload it first, then name it here.

kind.description: What the evidence is: a File uploaded to OneUptime, or a Link to evidence kept somewhere else. It can't be changed.

name.description: What the evidence is, in a few words. A file's own name when none is given.
name.example: This is an example of longer text content that might be stored in this field.

projectId.description: ID of the project this evidence belongs to.

securityCaseId.description: ID of the case this evidence is kept on.

url.description: Where the evidence is kept, for Link evidence: an http or https address.

name: create_security_case_evidence
title: Create Security Case Evidence
